Game Overview

In Candy Buff, the core idea is straightforward: leap through vibrant, candy-filled worlds with just one button. Master the art of timing to double-jump and dodge obstacles. Collect stars to speed up, snatch power-ups, and extend your jumps. But be cautious—mistakes send you back to the beginning! Can you outpace your sweet tooth?

Playing Candy Buff comes down to a simple loop. Leap through vibrant, candy-filled worlds with just one button! Master the art of timing to double-jump and dodge obstacles.
